issues.description: Inconsistent return types and error handling for the POST create endpoint for persons: the NoteResource.createNote endpoint uses ResponseEntity<Note> and returns ResponseEntity.badRequest() on invalid input, while the implemented PersonResource.createPerson returns a raw Person and returns null on invalid input. This is inconsistent with the style used for other REST endpoints and with the problem statement's expectation that endpoints return proper HTTP responses. Students may be confused whether to implement PersonResource.createPerson to return a ResponseEntity or a raw Person and how to signal invalid requests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the PersonResource.createPerson endpoint consistent with NoteResource by returning ResponseEntity<Person>. On invalid input return ResponseEntity.badRequest().build(), and on success return ResponseEntity.ok(personService.savePerson(person)). Update the method signature to ResponseEntity<Person> and adjust tests/clients accordingly so all REST endpoints consistently use ResponseEntity for status control.
